New telemetry projects current observed velocity and nose into the current road frame; it does not predict future clearance or recommend controls.
Removing two explicit current-state badges leaves all other body facts intact, including edge clearance, grip and road geometry.
Instantaneous left/right motion, fixed-input half-second risk, optimal actions and live driving are different tasks.
Full per-case observations/traces reconstruct exactly. Reflected rendered numbers allow0.0021 projection/rounding tolerance with exact categories.
